description: WRITE-LV, what the earlier 3186 depends on. Process a holds a dynaset over table M positioned on row 1 (3,000-character memos, no Edit); b replaces the memo of rows 1 to 4 (3,500 characters, Errors before/after); a starts Edit on row 1 and b replaces rows 1 to 3; a CancelUpdate and closes; b replaces row 1 and reads the memo lengths after a pause. Asks whether a merely positioned recordset, a pending Edit or only the same row blocks a memo replacement.
